learning.learning_goal: Understand that difference names the gap between two amounts.
learning.big_idea: The difference is the amount between two values, not either value by itself.

screens.label: Lesson 003
screens.title: Difference
screens.body: Difference is the name for the gap between two amounts.

visual.message: Match the blocks in both rows. What remains unmatched?

screens.label: Discover
screens.title: What does the highlighted part represent?

visual.message: The unmatched blocks are the difference between 13 and 8.

choices.feedback: The difference is the unmatched part between the amounts.

hints: Match one block in the top row with one in the bottom row.
Focus on the blocks without a partner.
The unmatched part is the gap, or difference.

screens.label: Language
screens.title: Several questions ask for a difference.

visual.message: Each phrase asks about the same gap.

screens.guidance: Do not use the word more by itself to choose an operation. Decide whether the question asks you to combine or compare.

screens.label: Symbol
screens.title: Which equation finds the difference?

visual.message: Measure the unmatched part from the larger amount to the smaller amount.

choices.feedback: Subtracting the smaller amount from the larger amount measures the difference.

hints: The question asks for the gap, not the combined total.
Start with the larger amount and subtract the smaller amount.

visual.message: Five blocks are unmatched, so the difference is 5.

screens.label: Reflect
screens.title: What does difference mean?
screens.prompt: Choose the statement that explains the idea.

choices.text: Difference means the gap between two amounts.
choices.feedback: The difference describes how far apart the amounts are.

choices.text: Difference means add the amounts together.

hints: Think about the highlighted unmatched blocks.
Difference describes a relationship between two amounts.

screens.title: You found the difference.
screens.body: You connected comparison language, the visual gap, and subtraction.
screens.nextRecommendation: Next: use the difference when the compared amount is unknown.
